reason: First invalid primary round S1-B-p95-q100-r2 had clustered transport_timeout; retain failures and require at least five valid repeats.
selection: Use only validity and source audit, never latency, stale ratio, or improvement size, to decide supplementation.
unit: Entire story/rate/read-ratio condition: all A/B/C/D arms, or all A/B-off/B in reverse.
repeat: Start from repeat 6 and increase; same repeat seed across all arms; alternate order by repeat parity.
aggregation: Retain and report every attempted run; include all valid attempts in descriptive statistics and report counts; pairwise conclusions also use common valid repeat identifiers.

clarifications.rule: Require at least five common valid repeat identifiers for each reported strategy comparison, as well as at least five valid attempts per arm. Different invalid repeat numbers in A and B may require more than one whole-cell supplementary repeat. Selection still uses only validity, never performance.
